title: shots.json: shots, boundaries, crops, text in the bars, motion and brightness (layer L1 of panorama.content/0)
description: One entry per shot covering the whole film, first frame to last, in order. Derived from signals.bin in seconds: a policy change re-derives it without decoding. Stretches the full scan has not reached are cut at their keyframes and flagged provisional, with crops from the keyframes' own rectangles, so a planner can start from the pre-scan alone. `start_s` is the cue-sheet shot start (halfway between the last frame of the previous shot and the first frame of this one on the rebased timeline; 0 for the first shot), so a cue sheet can copy it. `end_s` is the next shot's start (for the last shot, the end of the last frame). The table points at no other table: slide-paths.json and subjects.json name their shot by id, so each of the three can be made again alone. Time and space conventions: common.schema.json.

counts.description: Shots, and the boundaries by source: TransNetV2 hard cuts, TransNetV2 gradual transitions, provisional keyframe boundaries.

params.description: The thresholds and tolerances this derivation used (policy: cheap to change).

vocabulary.description: The file's real picture rectangles. A shot's crop is the smallest mode that contains the shot's evidence.

share.description: Share of the evidence frames (shot lengths).

boundary_in.description: The boundary that starts this shot. kind: start (file start), hard (a cut), gradual (dissolve, fade, wipe: span is the transition's frame range), keyframe (provisional, unscanned stretch). Scores are TransNetV2's: p_single is the single-frame head's probability of a cut here, p_many the many-hot head's probability of a transition. keyframe_aligned: a keyframe lies within one frame (74% of the research episode's cuts do).

layout_safe.description: True where the picture may change layout unseen (a hard cut or a gradual transition found by the shot model). False for the first shot and for provisional keyframe boundaries.

provisional.description: True when some frame of the shot is not scanned: the boundaries and crop come from keyframes only.

crop.description: The picture rectangle of the shot. rect is null before any confident crop exists (nothing is cropped, ADR 0010). evidence: normal (at least half the frames gave a usable rectangle), dark (fewer), keyframe (provisional: only the keyframe's rectangle), no_valid_frames (none: the last confident crop is held, held_from_previous). A frame's rectangle is usable when it is bar-shaped: full width or full height within 12 px.

confidence.description: Share of usable frames within 4 px of the shot's union, scaled down when fewer than 8 frames back it.

bar_content.description: Text or logos found inside the bars of this shot's crop. extend: how many pixels the crop must reach into each bar (from the picture edge outward) to keep the text, 0 when none; text_frames: frames of the shot with text on that side (runs of at least 3 frames; a bright line starts at least 8 px inside the bar). The planner's final crop is crop.rect extended by these amounts.

luma.description: Brightness over the scanned frames of the shot, 8-bit code values of the stream (HDR code values are not nits): mean luma, the highest and the mean 95th percentile.

motion.description: Global picture motion over the shot's step pairs: held_share (steps that repeat the same drawing), speed_px_s_p50 / p90 (typical and fast shift speed of the non-held steps, source pixels per second), speed_picture_heights_s_p90 (the same divided by the stored height).
